ANSWER: The function that builds the renamed path is `ConflictForkPath` in `pkg/sync/reconcile.go`. It takes the original file path and the local `vault.TreeEntry`, calls `ConflictLocalPath` (also in the same file) to form the base name (e.g. `ideas.conflict-local.md`), then appends a short hash derived from `local.PlaintextHash` to make the name unique per device (e.g. `ideas.conflict-local-1a2b3c4d.md`). The plaintext hash (not the encrypted blob hash) is used because encrypted envelopes are non-deterministic across devices. `ApplyConflictFailsafe` (also in `pkg/sync/reconcile.go`) is the caller that invokes `ConflictForkPath` for each detected conflict and writes the local version under that renamed path.

- **`pkg/sync/reconcile.go`** — `ConflictForkPath` (builds the hash-suffixed rename), `ConflictLocalPath` (builds the base `.conflict-local` name), `ApplyConflictFailsafe` (applies the policy to the merged tree)
